'''Pi Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] unit serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They fought rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].
